notes: Promulgated 2018-12-19: regulatory sandbox for autonomous land, sea and air vehicles with legal exemptions, review committee and liability/insurance rules.

title_en: Regulations Governing Unmanned Vehicle Technology Innovative Experimentation

title_original: 無人載具科技創新實驗審查會議運作辦法

notes: Issued 2019-06-06: composition and procedures of the sandbox review committee.

notes: Issued 2019-07-02: public disclosure of experiments and assessment/reporting of safety incidents.

title_en: Regulations on Issuance of Plates for Unmanned Vehicle Innovative Experimentation Projects

title_en: Act for Strengthening Defense Autonomy and Development of the Unmanned Vehicle Industry

title_en: Civil Aviation Act (Chapter 9-2 on Remotely Piloted Aircraft)

title_en: Regulations Governing Remotely Piloted Aircraft

notes: Issued 2019, in force 2020-03-31, amended to 2024-11-14: drone registration, inspection, operator certificates, operating limitations.

title_en: Rules for Investigation of Major Flight Accidents Involving Remotely Piloted Aircraft
notes: Issued 2020-03-04: investigation procedures for major drone accidents.

title_original: 遙控無人機檢驗及操作人員測驗委託辦法
title_en: Regulations on Delegation of Drone Inspection and Operator Testing
notes: Issued 2020-02-21: delegation of drone inspections and operator exams to designated bodies.

title_original: 商港區域特定範圍內遙控無人機飛航活動申請及管理辦法
title_en: Regulations on Application and Management of Drone Flights within Designated Commercial Port Areas
notes: Issued 2026-02-09: permits and management of drone flights in commercial port areas.

title_original: 北京市人民政府关于公布无人驾驶航空器管制空域范围的通告
title_en: Notice of Beijing Municipal Government Publishing the Scope of Controlled Airspace for Unmanned Aircraft
notes: Aug 2025 notice defining controlled airspace for drones in Beijing under the national UAS flight regulations.

title_original: Road Traffic Ordinance (Cap. 374), Part VIIIA Autonomous Vehicles (inserted by Road Traffic (Amendment) Ordinance 2023)
title_en: Road Traffic Ordinance (Cap. 374), Part VIIIA Autonomous Vehicles
notes: 2023 amendment ordinance added Part VIIIA creating a pilot licensing regime for autonomous vehicles (in force 2024-03-01); e-Legislation page is JS-rendered.

title_original: Road Traffic (Autonomous Vehicles) Regulation (Cap. 374AF)
title_en: Road Traffic (Autonomous Vehicles) Regulation
issuer: Secretary for Transport and Logistics (subsidiary legislation under Cap. 374)
notes: In force 2024-03-01: pilot licences for AV testing/use, safety requirements, operators and insurance; cap number (374AF or 374AE) to be confirmed on e-Legislation.

title_original: Small Unmanned Aircraft Order (Cap. 448G)
title_en: Small Unmanned Aircraft Order (Cap. 448G)
issuer: Chief Executive in Council (subsidiary legislation under Civil Aviation Ordinance Cap. 448)
notes: In force 2022-06-01: risk-based regime for small unmanned aircraft (registration, labelling, pilot ratings, operating restrictions, advanced operations permissions).

title_original: Achtes Gesetz zur Änderung des Straßenverkehrsgesetzes vom 16. Juni 2017 (BGBl. I S. 1648)
title_en: Eighth Act amending the Road Traffic Act of 16 June 2017 (automated driving)
notes: Amending act that inserted §§1a–1c and §63a StVG: permits highly/fully automated driving functions, driver rights/duties, event data storage, higher liability caps.

title_original: Verordnung zur Regelung des Betriebs von unbemannten Fluggeräten vom 30. März 2017 (BGBl. I S. 683)
title_en: Ordinance regulating the operation of unmanned aircraft of 30 March 2017 (drone ordinance)
issuer: Bundesministerium für Verkehr und digitale Infrastruktur / Bundesrat
notes: Germany's first comprehensive drone ordinance: labelling duty, knowledge certificate, 100 m altitude cap, no-fly zones; largely replaced by 2021 LuftVO recast under EU rules.

title_original: Ordonnance n° 2016-1057 du 3 août 2016 relative à l'expérimentation de véhicules à délégation de conduite sur les voies publiques
title_en: Ordinance No. 2016-1057 of 3 August 2016 on the experimentation of vehicles with delegated driving on public roads
issuer: Gouvernement (Président de la République) – Ministère de l'environnement/transports
notes: Requires ministerial authorisation for any on-road test of partially or fully automated vehicles; basis for décret 2018-211; amended by loi PACTE 2019 to allow tests without driver on board.

title_original: Décret n° 2018-211 du 28 mars 2018 relatif à l'expérimentation de véhicules à délégation de conduite sur les voies publiques
title_en: Decree No. 2018-211 of 28 March 2018 on the experimentation of vehicles with delegated driving on public roads
issuer: Premier ministre / Ministère chargé des transports
notes: Sets authorisation procedure (max 2 years renewable), consultations, WW DPTC provisional registration, human driver able to retake control, data recording, suspension powers for AV tests.

title_original: Loi n° 2019-1428 du 24 décembre 2019 d'orientation des mobilités (LOM) – articles 31 et 32 (véhicules autonomes et véhicules connectés)
title_en: Law No. 2019-1428 of 24 December 2019 on mobility orientation (LOM) – articles 31–32 on autonomous and connected vehicles
notes: Empowers the government to legislate by ordinance on liability and use conditions for automated vehicles and automated road transport systems; data access provisions for connected vehicles.

title_original: Ordonnance n° 2021-443 du 14 avril 2021 relative au régime de responsabilité pénale applicable en cas de circulation d'un véhicule à délégation de conduite et à ses conditions d'utilisation
title_en: Ordinance No. 2021-443 of 14 April 2021 on the criminal liability regime for the circulation of vehicles with delegated driving and their conditions of use
issuer: Gouvernement – Ministère de la transition écologique (transports)
notes: Shifts criminal liability to the manufacturer while the automated driving system is engaged; amends Code de la route (L.123-1 ff.), Code des transports (automated road transport systems) and Code.

title_original: Décret n° 2021-873 du 29 juin 2021 portant application de l'ordonnance n° 2021-443 du 14 avril 2021 relative au régime de responsabilité pénale applicable en cas de circulation d'un véhicule à délégation de conduite et à ses conditions d'utilisation
title_en: Decree No. 2021-873 of 29 June 2021 implementing Ordinance No. 2021-443 on criminal liability and conditions of use of vehicles with delegated driving
issuer: Premier ministre / Ministère chargé des transports
notes: Defines partially/highly/fully automated vehicles, driver duties during delegation, conditions of use information, remote operator rules and safety demonstration for automated road transport systems.

title_original: Loi n° 2016-1428 du 24 octobre 2016 relative au renforcement de la sécurité de l'usage des drones civils
title_en: Law No. 2016-1428 of 24 October 2016 on strengthening the safety of civil drone use
notes: Civil drone law: registration of UAS above 800 g, remote pilot training, electronic/light signalling, flight-limitation devices, criminal sanctions for overflying prohibited zones.

title_original: Verordnung vom 13. Dezember 2024 über das automatisierte Fahren (VAF), SR 741.59
title_en: Ordinance of 13 December 2024 on Automated Driving (VAF), SR 741.59
notes: In force 1 March 2025: permits motorway autopilot (hands-off), driverless vehicles on approved routes with remote supervision, and automated parking; approval and operator duties.

title_original: Strassenverkehrsgesetz (SVG) – Änderung vom 17. März 2023 (automatisiertes Fahren, Art. 25a ff.), AS 2023 453
title_en: Road Traffic Act (SVG) – amendment of 17 March 2023 on automated driving (art. 25a ff.), AS 2023 453
notes: Delegates to the Federal Council the power to exempt vehicles with automation systems from driver duties; legal basis for VAF; parts in force from 2025 per partial entry-into-force ordinances AS.

title_original: Verordnung des UVEK vom 24. November 2022 über Luftfahrzeuge besonderer Kategorien (VLK), SR 748.941
title_en: DETEC Ordinance of 24 November 2022 on Aircraft of Special Categories (VLK), SR 748.941 – national drone rules
issuer: Eidgenössisches Departement für Umwelt, Verkehr, Energie und Kommunikation (UVEK)
notes: National implementation of EU UAS rules (2019/947) adopted by Switzerland from 1 Jan 2023: operating conditions for drones, geographic zones, model aircraft associations.

title_original: Legge 27 dicembre 2017, n. 205 (Legge di bilancio 2018), art. 1 comma 72 – sperimentazione su strada di veicoli a guida automatica / Smart Road
title_en: Law No. 205 of 27 December 2017 (Budget Law 2018), art. 1 para. 72 – authorisation of on-road testing of automated vehicles
notes: Statutory basis authorising experimentation of automated driving on public roads and delegating implementing rules to the Smart Road ministerial decree.

title_original: Legge 23 settembre 2025, n. 132 – Disposizioni e deleghe al Governo in materia di intelligenza artificiale
title_en: Law No. 132 of 23 September 2025 – Provisions and delegations to the Government on artificial intelligence
notes: Italy's national AI law (in force 10 Oct 2025): sector rules for health (AI as support to clinicians, medical devices), work, professions, and delegations incl. criminal law; embodied relevance.

title_original: Arrêté royal du 10 avril 2016 relatif à l'utilisation des aéronefs télépilotés dans l'espace aérien belge
title_en: Royal Decree of 10 April 2016 on the use of remotely piloted aircraft in Belgian airspace
notes: Belgium's first civil drone regulation (class 1/class 2 RPAS, pilot licences, registration, operating limits); replaced by EU 2019/947 framework and the Royal Decree of 8 Nov 2020.

title_original: Liiklusseaduse muutmise seadus (robotliikur) – vastu võetud 14. juunil 2017; Liiklusseadus § 2 p 69¹ jt
title_en: Traffic Act amendment of 14 June 2017 introducing the 'self-driving delivery robot' (robotliikur) vehicle category
notes: First EU national law legalising sidewalk delivery robots (max 6 km/h, 50 kg, insurance, identification marking, remote or direct human control); English consolidated Traffic Act.

title_original: Loi n° 2015-992 du 17 août 2015 relative à la transition énergétique pour la croissance verte – article 37 IX (habilitation à légiférer sur les véhicules à délégation de conduite)
title_en: Law No. 2015-992 of 17 August 2015 on energy transition for green growth – article 37 IX (authorisation to legislate by ordinance on vehicles with delegated driving)
notes: Statutory habilitation enabling the 2016 ordinance on experimentation of automated vehicles on public roads.

title_original: Arrêté du 17 avril 2018 relatif à l'expérimentation de véhicules à délégation de conduite sur les voies publiques
title_en: Order of 17 April 2018 on the experimentation of vehicles with delegated driving on public roads
issuer: Ministre chargé des transports et ministre de l'intérieur
notes: Sets the content of the AV test application file, WW DPTC certificate rules, monitoring and reporting requirements (NOR TRER1717820A).

title_original: Loi n° 2019-486 du 22 mai 2019 relative à la croissance et la transformation des entreprises (PACTE) – article 125 (expérimentation de véhicules à délégation de conduite)
title_en: Law No. 2019-486 of 22 May 2019 on business growth and transformation (PACTE) – article 125 on automated vehicle experimentation
notes: Amends ordinance 2016-1057: allows tests without driver on board under remote supervision, exempts driver from attention duty while system active, assigns fines/criminal liability to the.

title_original: Ordonnance n° 2021-442 du 14 avril 2021 relative à l'accès aux données des véhicules
title_en: Ordinance No. 2021-442 of 14 April 2021 on access to vehicle data
issuer: Gouvernement – Ministère de la transition écologique (transports)
notes: Creates a Code des transports chapter on access to data of connected and automated vehicles (accident investigation, road operators, insurers); companion to ordinance 2021-443.

title_original: Décret n° 2022-1034 du 21 juillet 2022 portant publication de l'amendement à la convention internationale sur la circulation routière de Vienne du 8 novembre 1968 (systèmes de conduite automatisée)
title_en: Decree No. 2022-1034 of 21 July 2022 publishing the amendment to the 1968 Vienna Convention on Road Traffic (automated driving systems)
issuer: Président de la République / Ministère de l'Europe et des affaires étrangères

title_original: Arrêté du 2 août 2022 portant application de l'article R. 3152-3 du code des transports relatif à l'habilitation des intervenants à distance dans le cadre des systèmes de transport routier automatisé
title_en: Order of 2 August 2022 on the qualification of remote operators of automated road transport systems (art. R. 3152-3 Code des transports)
notes: Medical fitness, training and competence certificates for remote intervention operators and supervisors of driverless shuttles/robotaxi services (NOR TRET2223078A).

title_original: Arrêté du 2 août 2022 pris en application de l'article R. 3152-30 du code des transports, relatif à la procédure d'agrément des organismes qualifiés (systèmes de transport routier automatisé)
title_en: Order of 2 August 2022 on the approval procedure for qualified bodies assessing automated road transport systems (art. R. 3152-30 Code des transports)
notes: Requirements for organismes qualifiés agréés that audit safety demonstrations of automated road transport systems; processed by STRMTG (NOR TRET2219624A).

title_original: Arrêté du 8 décembre 2022 fixant le contenu et les modalités de fourniture de l'information obligatoire relative aux conditions d'utilisation du système de conduite automatisé équipant un véhicule
title_en: Order of 8 December 2022 on the mandatory consumer information about conditions of use of a vehicle's automated driving system
issuer: Ministre de l'économie (DGCCRF) et ministre chargé des transports
notes: Implements art. R.311-1 Code de la route: sellers/renters must inform consumers of the ADS operating conditions and limits (NOR ECOC2213191A).

title_original: Décret n° 2023-644 du 20 juillet 2023 relatif à l'accès à certaines données des véhicules pour la prévention des accidents, la connaissance de l'infrastructure routière et du trafic
title_en: Decree No. 2023-644 of 20 July 2023 on access to certain vehicle data for accident prevention, road infrastructure mapping and traffic knowledge
issuer: Premier ministre / Ministère chargé des transports
notes: Implementing decree of ordinance 2021-442: data access, retention and disclosure rules for connected/automated vehicle data (NOR TRET2311891D).

title_original: Décret n° 2024-1063 du 25 novembre 2024 relatif au transport routier automatisé de marchandises
title_en: Decree No. 2024-1063 of 25 November 2024 on automated road freight transport
issuer: Premier ministre / Ministère chargé des transports
notes: Extends the automated road transport system (STRA) safety regime to driverless freight vehicles: safety demonstration, roles of organiser/designer/operator (NOR PTDT2408874D).

title_original: Arrêté du 15 avril 2025 relatif à la sécurité de l'exploitation des systèmes de transport routier automatisés utilisant des véhicules totalement automatisés pour le transport en commun de personnes
title_en: Order of 15 April 2025 on operational safety of automated road transport systems using fully automated vehicles for public passenger transport
notes: Safety requirements for operating driverless shuttles/buses without onboard driver incl. remote interventions (NOR ATDT2509764A).

title_original: Федеральный закон от 31 июля 2020 г. № 258-ФЗ «Об экспериментальных правовых режимах в сфере цифровых инноваций в Российской Федерации»
title_en: Federal Law No. 258-FZ of 31 July 2020 on Experimental Legal Regimes in the Field of Digital Innovation in the Russian Federation
notes: Regulatory sandbox law under which Russia established experimental legal regimes for driverless vehicles (Moscow, federal highways), drone delivery and medical AI.

title_original: Arrêté du Gouvernement en Conseil du 25 octobre 2024 déterminant la composition et le fonctionnement du comité interministériel de coordination pour la conduite automatisée
title_en: Government-in-Council Order of 25 October 2024 determining the composition and functioning of the interministerial coordination committee for automated driving
notes: Creates the interministerial committee coordinating Luxembourg's automated driving policy and test authorisations (members appointed by order of 22 Nov 2024).

title_original: Règlement grand-ducal du 22 décembre 2025 relatif aux aéronefs sans équipage à bord
title_en: Grand-Ducal Regulation of 22 December 2025 on unmanned aircraft

notes: National drone regulation complementing EU 2019/947: geographic zones, operator obligations and national procedures for unmanned aircraft in Luxembourg airspace.

title_original: Decreto-Lei n.º 58/2018, de 23 de julho – regime de registo e seguro de responsabilidade civil obrigatório para aeronaves não tripuladas (drones)

title_original: SHGM İnsansız Hava Aracı Sistemleri Talimatı (SHT-İHA) ve İHA kayıt sistemi

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2018/1139 on common rules in the field of civil aviation and establishing a European Union Aviation Safety Agency

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 on type-approval requirements for motor vehicles ... as regards their general safety (General Safety Regulation)

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2018/858 on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers
title_en: Regulation (EU) 2018/858 vehicle type-approval framework

title_original: Directive (EU) 2023/2661 amending Directive 2010/40/EU on the framework for the deployment of Intelligent Transport Systems
title_en: Directive (EU) 2023/2661 amending the ITS Directive (connected and automated mobility)
notes: Extends the ITS Directive to cooperative, connected and automated mobility, mandates data availability and interoperability supporting automated driving.

title_original: Directive (EU) 2024/2853 on liability for defective products and repealing Council Directive 85/374/EEC
title_en: Product Liability Directive (EU) 2024/2853
notes: Strict liability extended to software and AI systems, updates, self-learning, cybersecurity defects; disclosure and presumptions of defect; applies to products placed on the market from 9 Dec 2026.

title_original: Council Directive 85/374/EEC on liability for defective products
title_en: Product Liability Directive 85/374/EEC
notes: Original strict product liability regime applicable to robots and vehicles as products; repealed by Directive 2024/2853 with effect from 9 Dec 2026.

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 on the safety of toys and repealing Directive 2009/48/EC
title_en: Toy Safety Regulation (EU) 2025/2509
notes: New toy safety rules incl. digital product passport, cybersecurity, privacy and mental-health safeguards for connected/AI toys (robot toys); applies after a 54-month transition.

title_original: Directive 2009/48/EC on the safety of toys
title_en: Toy Safety Directive 2009/48/EC
notes: Essential safety requirements and CE marking for toys incl. robotic and electronic toys; to be repealed by Reg 2025/2509.

title_original: Directive 2009/104/EC concerning the minimum safety and health requirements for the use of work equipment by workers at work
title_en: Work Equipment Directive 2009/104/EC
notes: Employer duties for selection, risk assessment, maintenance and training on work equipment, applied to industrial/collaborative robots and occupational exoskeletons in use (complements Machinery law).

title_original: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/30 supplementing Directive 2014/53/EU with regard to the application of the essential requirements referred to in Article 3(3), points (d), (e) and (f)

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 on harmonised rules on fair access to and use of data (Data Act)

title_original: Ilmailulaki (864/2014)

title_original: Lov om utprøving av selvkjørende kjøretøy (LOV-2017-12-15-112)
title_en: Act on the testing of self-driving vehicles (Norway)

title_original: Forskrift om utprøving av selvkjørende motorvogn (FOR-2017-12-19-2240)

title_original: Forskrift om luftfartøy som ikke har fører om bord mv. (BSL A 7-1, FOR-2015-11-30-1404)

notes: Norway's original RO1-RO3 drone operator regulation; now applies only to state aviation with unmanned aircraft after EU rules took over civil drones.

title_original: Forskrift om U-space og krav til en integrert digital luftfartspublikasjon for brukere av luftrommet (BSL A 7-3, FOR-2024-10-23-2572)
title_en: Regulation on U-space and an integrated digital aeronautical publication (Norway, BSL A 7-3)
notes: Implements EU U-space Regs 2021/664-666 in Norway for digital drone traffic management airspace.

title_original: Færdselsloven (lovbekendtgørelse nr. 1312 af 26. november 2024) – §§ 92 f-92 h forsøg med selvkørende motorkøretøjer

title_original: DoD Directive 3000.09, Autonomy in Weapon Systems (updated 25 January 2023; original 2012)

notes: Binding DoD policy: autonomous/semi-autonomous weapons must allow appropriate levels of human judgment over use of force; senior review before development and fielding.

title_original: Code de la sécurité routière (RLRQ c. C-24.2), art. 633.1 - projets pilotes relatifs aux véhicules autonomes (introduit par la Loi 2018, c. 7 / projet de loi 165)
title_en: Highway Safety Code (CQLR c. C-24.2), s. 633.1 - pilot projects on autonomous vehicles (introduced by Bill 165, S.Q. 2018 c. 7)
notes: 2018 HSC reform defining autonomous vehicles and empowering the Minister, after consulting SAAQ, to authorize AV pilot projects by order that prevail over the Code.

title_original: مرسوم بقانون اتحادي رقم (26) لسنة 2022 في شأن تنظيم الطائرات بدون طيار
title_en: Federal Decree-Law No. (26) of 2022 Concerning the Regulation of Unmanned Aircraft
